# Pictify

> API-first image, document, and video generation. Every row of a spreadsheet or a webhook payload becomes a rendered, personalized certificate, badge, report, or video, delivered by email with per-recipient delivery and bounce status tracked.

Pictify renders HTML/CSS as images (PNG/JPG/WebP), screenshots arbitrary URLs, generates multi-page PDFs, and renders video from templates authored visually or in code (Remotion). Workflows connect a CSV upload or a signed webhook to a template and a delivery pipeline in one step.

Pictify's core pattern is the **Render-to-Recipient workflow**: data in (CSV row, webhook payload, or API call) → document or video rendered from a template → emailed to that row's recipient → delivered/bounced status reported per person. Rendering and delivery are one run, not two products.

## Developer guides

- [HTML to Image API: The Complete Developer Guide](https://pictify.io/blogs/html-to-image-the-complete-developer-guide-2026): client-side (html2canvas/html-to-image/dom-to-image) vs. headless browsers (Puppeteer/Playwright) vs. rendering APIs: failure modes, production code, benchmarks
- [Website Screenshot API: The Complete Developer Guide](https://pictify.io/blogs/website-screenshot-api-the-complete-developer-guide-2026): cookie banners, SPA wait-timing, mobile emulation, full-page capture, the auth-wall limitation

## Solutions

- [Mail Merge with Attachments](https://pictify.io/solutions/mail-merge-with-attachments): a personalized PDF per spreadsheet row, emailed to each recipient
- [Video Mail Merge](https://pictify.io/solutions/video-mail-merge): the same pattern, video instead of documents
